GENERAL INFORMATION
(Summary of the main regulations)
EQUIPMENT - All VARIG flights scheduled to New York are
operated by a fleet of Lockheed Super-Constellations, piloted by
CAA licensed transoceanic crews. VARIG Airlines has been certi-
fied by the Civil Aeronautics Board to operate a regular schedu-
led service between New York and Rio de Janeiro. These flights
are extended southbound to soo Poulo. Porto Alecre, montevidec
and buenos Alres.
SERVICES - VARIG offers both First-Class and Tourist-Class
flights. First-Class is equipped with luxurious seating. and das-
DEPARTURES - Passengers are requested to be at embar-
KaTion Doints or the time indicoree on he icker cover in oreer
to complete oil tormalities. Deportures will not be deloved to
accommodate passengers not arriving in time.
BAGGAGE ALLOWANCE - The free baggage allowance
is 20 kilos (44 Ibs.) for journeys for which the tourist class fare
is paid, and 30 kilos (66 Ibs.) for journeys for which the first
class fare is paid. Overcoats, umbrellas, lady's handbags and
small cameras will not be weighed as "baggage", but are to be
marked with the passenger's name and address. Excess weiaht
above free allowance will be charged for at 1% of the first class
adult one-way tare per kilo or 2.2 ibs.
CHILDREN. Infants in arms, not occupyina a seat, will be
charged 10% of the applicable normal adult fare. Children over
2 and under 12 years of age, or infants occupying an individual
seat, or in excess of one per adult passenger,
50% of the applicable normal adult fare. Children may travel
alone anly under certain conditions.
RESERVATIONS - Passengers must reconfirm their reser-
vations at each stopover city at least 72 hours before scheduled
departure from
the stopover.
STOPOVER - Stopovers will be permitted if reservations are
made accordingly, and provided the passenger holds a valid visa.
TAXES - Any taxes imposed by
Governmental Authorities
shall be added to the price of fares
GROUND TRANSPORTATION - Taxicab and limousine
service is available between downtown scheduled check-in points
and the airport. at passenger's expense
HOTELS - VARIG will gladly arrange your hotel reservations
in any city served by the airline.
CONNECTIONS - Well-timed connecting services with other
international airlines are provided from Trujillo, Rio de Janeiro,
São Paulo and Buenos Aires. VARIG operates also domestic liner
linking more than 60 cities in Brazil. For complete information
ask your flight attendant, any VARIG representative or your
travel agent.
All flights, fares, schedules and other information published herein are subject
to changes without previous notice to the public.
